fields.description: When enabled, the New Shipment button is visible on the Shipment Manager desk page. Hidden by default.
fields.label: Show "New Shipment" Button on Shipment Desk

fields.description:
Code 128 — recommended for all modern 1-D laser/CCD scanners (supports full ASCII).
Code 39 — for legacy scanners; limited to A-Z, 0-9 and a few symbols.
QR Code — for 2-D / smartphone scanners.
fields.label: Barcode Type

fields.description: Embed the shipment barcode in the invoice printout and PDF download.
fields.label: Print barcode on invoice & PDF

fields.description: Height of the barcode bars in pixels. Minimum 40 for reliable scanning. QR code uses this as side length.
fields.label: Barcode Height (px)

fields.description: When unchecked, each desk user can only update one status per shipment. After that, a different user must perform the next status update. Only on Portal page.
fields.label: A User Can Update Multiple Status Of A Shipment

fields.description: When enabled, a Tracking ID input appears next to the Delivered status on the Update Shipment Status page. The tracking ID is also displayed on the Track page.
fields.label: Enable Tracking ID

fields.description:
Camera — opens the phone camera automatically to scan a barcode when clicking "+ Tracking ID".
Hardware Scanner — shows a text input that works with a plugged-in barcode scanner gun (HID keyboard input).
fields.label: Tracking ID Input Mode

fields.description: When enabled, shipment tracking uses the AfterShip API. When disabled, tracking uses the built-in status history from Courier Shipment.
fields.label: Use AfterShip for Tracking

fields.description: Stored securely. Used as the as-api-key header when calling the AfterShip tracking API.
fields.label: AfterShip API Key

fields.description: When enabled, the HS Code field on the Commodities table (Shipment Portal & Shipment Desk) is looked up via the HS code search API and is read-only until a code is picked. When disabled, users can type the HS Code directly.
fields.label: Fetch HS CODE from Api
